instruction.text: Joe says, “I divided 42 by an integer. My answer was 6.” Is this possible?
Sam says, “I multiplied 4 by an integer. My answer was 23.” Is this possible?
Sophie says, “I divided 47 by an integer. My answer was 8.”  Is this possible?
Rosie says, “I multiplied an integer by 8. My answer was 92.” Is this possible?
James says, “I multiplied an integer by 3. My answer was 33.”  Is this possible?
Julia says, “I divided an odd integer by 4. My answer was an integer.”  Is this possible?
Layla says, “I multiplied 4 and 8 together. I then multiplied that by an integer. My answer was divisible by 2. Is this possible?
Natalie says, “I multiplied an integer by 8. The answer is divisible by 4.”  Is this possible?
